name: meter
description: A graphical display of a numeric value inside a known range: disk used, a quota, a score against a target. A meter is a static measurement and not work under way, which is what separates it from progressbar: nothing is going anywhere, so a meter has no live region and announces nothing when it renders or changes. It takes no keyboard and no focus, because it is read and never operated; a meter a person can drag is a slider. aria-valuetext is optional in APG and so is not a requirement here, though a component may add it to say the value in words.

requires.roles.label: an accessible name from aria-label or aria-labelledby, naming what is measured
requires.states.valuenow: aria-valuenow set to the measured value, inside the range
requires.states.valuemin: aria-valuemin set to the lower bound of the range
requires.states.valuemax: aria-valuemax set to the upper bound of the range
